audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed everywhere flagged; cooldowns rewritten with digits; the no-dash fact stated; bleed bullets rewritten to match titles.

edits.before: Before 6 you have the better lane: your Threaded Volley shoves faster than her Mistral Bolt and your poke out-ranges her. At level 3 look for W into worked-ground E to root her; her only out is a short E dash on a long cooldown, so it's a reliable all-in window.
